title: 第13章 吾乃雷祖第14章 行云布雨
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
“主播？”
“林楠是个小网红啊？”
“不过扮演神明是什么意思？”
见同学们好奇的看过来，那个女生简单的解释了几句。
现在，大一三班乃至于周围几个班的同学，都已经知道了林楠是个网红。
于是大家纷纷对他产生了浓厚的兴趣。
看过林楠直播的，还真不算少数。
大概是同城推荐的缘故，其他班级也有认出他来的。
王玥本想与林楠聊几句，这下也被周围叽叽喳喳围过来的额好奇的声给劝退了。
她只好坐在了林楠身后，安静的听着。
“没想到咱们这届新生里竟然还有个网红！”
“兄弟，牛逼了！
人家角色扮演，都是明星、名人之类的，你直接就扮起神明来了！
可比他们高出了不止一个档次啊。”
林楠笑了笑说道：
“你们可别把我架这么高啊。”
“我一开始也没想扮神的，这都是网友们的意见。”
王成宇也插话道：
“是啊，楠哥的直播主打一个仙人指路，就是倍儿听劝！”
“要说也是他长得争气，别的主播想扮神，那外形条件也不允许啊！

你们说是吧？”
“哈哈哈哈”
王成宇几句话便逗笑了所有人，让大家短暂的忘记了军训的痛苦。
虽说军训的第一天，林楠就已经暴露了“身份”
但是也多亏了这件事，他们宿舍三人，很快便与同学们打成了一片。
休息时间很快结束，痛苦的训练再次袭来。
夕阳西下。
第一天军训结束的时候，大家几乎都是慢慢的才能挪回宿舍。
而林楠也庆幸，昨天提前跟网友们请了假，说隔天晚上再开播。
不然就这个状态，别说是扮不怒自威、气质威严的神明了，他直接都能去扮演非洲难民。
挺尸过了一晚之后，林楠这才觉得好了些。
……
时间飞逝。
content_en:
"Anchor?"
"Lin Nan is a little internet celebrity?"
"But what does it mean to play god?"
Seeing her classmates looking over curiously, the girl simply explained a few words.
Now, students from Class 3 and Class 1, as well as the surrounding classes, all know that Lin Nan is an internet celebrity.
So everyone became very interested in him.
There are really not a few people who have watched Lin Nan's live broadcast.
Probably because of recommendations from fellow students, other classes also recognized him.
Wang Yue originally wanted to chat with Lin Nan, but was dissuaded by the curious voices chattering around her.
She had no choice but to sit behind Lin Nan and listen quietly.
"I didn't expect that there would be an Internet celebrity among our freshmen!"
“Brother, that’s awesome!
People's role-playing is all about stars, celebrities, etc. You can directly pretend to be a god!
It's more than one level higher than them. "
Lin Nan smiled and said:
"Don't put me on such a high pedestal."
"I didn't want to pretend to be a god in the beginning. This is all the opinions of netizens."
Wang Chengyu also chimed in:
"Yeah, Brother Nan's live broadcast features an immortal guiding the way, and it's Beier who listens!"
“I would say that he is good-looking. If other anchors want to pretend to be gods, their physical appearance will not allow them!
You think so? "
"Hahahaha"
Wang Chengyu made everyone laugh with just a few words, making everyone temporarily forget the pain of military training.
Although on the first day of military training, Lin Nan had already exposed his "identity"
But thanks to this incident, the three of them in the dormitory quickly became involved with their classmates.
The break ended quickly and the painful training set in again.
The sun sets.
At the end of the first day of military training, everyone moved back to the dormitory slowly.
Lin Nan was also fortunate to have asked for leave from netizens in advance yesterday, saying that the show would start airing again the next night.
Otherwise, in this state, let alone playing the role of a god who is not angry and has a majestic temperament, he can directly play the role of an African refugee.
After standing up for a night, Lin Nan felt better.
…
Time flies.
